batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b RA Jadeja

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b JR Hazlewood

batting.name: Abdul Samad
batting.dismissal: c MM Ali b JR Hazlewood

batting.name: JO Holder
batting.dismissal: c DL Chahar b SN Thakur

balls.text: just short of Bravo at short third man! And guess what? Super Kings review. Phew. That was a yorker on leg, as Rashid looked to flick by clearing his front leg. Instead, replays confirm that he got a leading edge toward short third man, as the ball just landed short of the fielder.
bowls a sharp slower ball, which is short of a length outside off. Rashid looks to pull, but is beaten by the lack of pace
full-toss on middle bowled from wide of the crease. He lofts that with the full face of the bat, and lobs that toward the left of long-on
this is shorter in length and outside off. Pulled to deep midwicket while playing slightly away from his body
scooped over short fine leg! Chahar bowls on a good length on leg, and it is a change of pace again. Rashid is low and across off already, and ramps that over
slower ball to start with. Good length ball on off, and clipped to midwicket by Bhuvneshwar, as Chahar gives the chase to his right
continues bowling full and wide outside off. He opens the bat face, and slices that to third man, who runs to his right to stop that
and tries to repeat that shot, but is beaten. This is again very full, but just outside off

half a helicopter shot there! He stays deep in his crease, with his front leg outside off. He clears his front leg too, as Thakur bowls a low full-toss just outside off, which Rashid flicks to deep midwicket
very full and very wide of off. Left alone this time, and wide called
flashed just over short third man! Full and wide of off again, and this time reaches out for it to have a slash

good catch by Chahar at deep point! He goes low to his right at the last moment, and ends up pocketing it while falling to the ground. That was miles up in the air - and for a long time too - as Holder tried to repeat the shot from the previous ball by trying slash that full and wide ball outside off
goes after a full and wide ball outside off, and sends that sailing between deep point and third man. The latter runs in, and keeps that to two
nails a yorker on leg now! Rashid gets a horizontal bat down pretty late, and digs it out
again Rashid makes room, but is completely foxed by the slower ball! Bowls on a full length on leg, as the ball takes off over the stumps, which are exposed after Rashid gives himself room
another low full-toss on leg stump, as Holder flicks that to Hazlewood at fine leg. Still only a single for Sunrisers
makes room, as Bravo bowls really full on leg. Dragged to long-on
good length ball on leg, and flicked to deep square from deep in his crease
a low, dipping full-toss on his pads. A slower ball too, as Rashid lets that come before clipping that fine leg
and Hazlewood bowls full and wide of off again. But this time Rashid swings that all along the ground to deep point. Hazlewood finishes with 3 for 24, his best IPL figures

taken high by Moeen at point! Moeen times his slight jump well, and another Sunrisers wicket falls. Hazlewood pitches that really full and pretty wide of off. Samad tries to slice that over the man inside the circle, but doesn't time that all that well, as the ball lobs toward point, where Moeen is alert to the chance
very full and just wide of off. He opens the bat face to run that down to third man

taken by du Plessis at long-on! The ball was again full, but this time straighter on middle. He looks to lift that again, and this time over the bowler's head, but gets that off the bottom off the bat to lob that right down to the man, who is in fact a few steps inside the boundary

ridiculous! How could he do that? Hazlewood pitches it up close to the slot on off, and Abhishek remains deep in his crease and clears his front leg to loft that over extra cover. Effortless shot against a brilliant bowler
bisects short third man and point, as he opens the bat face to slice that very full ball outside off. But Moeen is sitting pretty at third man, and it is a single only
change of pace now. Yorker length ball and just outside off. Digs it out back to the bowler with a horizontal bat
another near yorker, but it is a low full-toss on middle and leg. He stays deep in his crease and clears his front leg to whip that to deep square leg
slower ball, and a near yorker on off. Flicked late and off the bottom off the bat to long-on while staying deep in his crease
this time Hazlewood is back on the fine leg fence, as Samad pulls this good length ball on leg for a single
a full-toss, and wide of off. He reaches out for it, and also loses his bottom hand, as the ball flies off his bat to deep point, which is straightish

excellent stop by Hazlewood at short fine leg! Goes low to his left, and stretches out his hand to stop a certain boundary - in fact he even clips the stumps at the keeper's end with his left-handed throw - as Bravo bowls a full-toss on leg, which Samad clips behind the wicket. A single only in the end
full ball on off, and clipped to midwicket, where the man is right on the edge of the circle
bowls a shortish ball on middle, which is angling away a touch. Misses his flick, as the ball takes his pad and rolls over toward fine leg for a leg-bye
full delivery on off, and tapped toward mid-off. Raina at cover rushes to left to get a hand and prevent a single
bowls pretty full on middle, with the ball angling in. Flicked to Moeen at fine leg
yorker length just outside off, and drilled to mid-off. du Plessis doesn't collect it cleanly, but no scope of a run there
that is a gorgeous shot! Simply presents the full face of the bat to loft that full ball in the slot on off, and gets his arms aloft to clear long-on

pulled fine, and for four! Short of a length ball, and pitching outside leg. All Abhishek has to do is swivel with his pull, and get a faint piece of bat to run that down to the fine leg fence and beat Dhoni to his right
goes short of a length on off now. Pulled to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
slashed to deep point! Slower ball from Thakur, and it is on a good length and pretty wide of off. He opens the bat face to hammer that to Moeen's right at deep point
continues bowling into the pitch, and on a good length just outside off. Punched off the back foot to Raina at cover
another good length ball on middle, and flicked toward deep square this time after the ball gets good bounce. His bottom comes off late, while Thakur again runs after the ball
clips this good length ball on middle toward deep midwicket. The fielder is right back on the fence, and so Thakur himself has to give chase. He runs back and slides to stop the ball
full again, but on his pads this time and at 99kph. Flicked to fine leg with the closed face of the bat
fullish on off, and driven to long-off with the full face of the bat
strikes his front pad, but sliding down leg. Full ball on middle and leg, and going down leg further. Half an appeal by Jadeja, but not given

and this is a simpler catch for Dhoni! This is on a good length on middle, and not all that short for Saha to pull. But he still goes for it from deep in his crease, and gets a top edge. The ball just lands to his left, after Dhoni takes a few steps forward to pocket that. Sunrisers tumbling here, with their run rate already six an over
good length ball on middle, and clipped to fine leg
very full and just outside off. Tapped to cover for a quick single
goes down on his back knee to this full ball outside off, and sweeps to fine leg all along the ground
tickles that nearly off Dhoni's glove, as Moeen bowls fullish and just outside off. But Saha taps that late, and close to his body
shorter in length, and just outside off. Cut to cover this time for another dor
good length ball on middle, and turning into him. Pushed to Raina at midwicket
opens the bat face to this full ball outside off, and drives to deep point with his bottom hand off
dabs this fullish ball just outside off to short third man by playing late and allowing it to come to him
slower ball, and a low, dipping full-toss on middle. Clipped to deep midwicket

Dhoni runs a few steps to his left, and pouches that safely! Bravo pitches it short of a length just outside off, as Garg pulls but gets a top edge. The ball takes off high after hitting his bat, as Dhoni moves to his left while signaling to the fielders near him that he is happy to go for it
full-toss on middle, and Saha presents the full face of the bat to push that to deep midwicket
slower ball, and fullish and veryyyy wide of off. Dhoni has to go miles to his right to stop that. Wide called, and naturally so
continues bowling full and straight on off. Pushed back to the bowler
near yorker, and swinging in too. He opens the bat face, but the ball flies off the outside half of the bat toward point
full delivery just outside off, and he drives right to the man at cover
full on off. Swept firmly to deep backward square leg. Two on offer, and completed despite a tidy throw.
full on middle stump. Nudged off the front foot to midwicket. Jadeja and Dhoni both give the ball a chase
full outside off. Driven to wide long off for a single
full outside off. Bit of turn away. Misses the defensive shot
nudges this full ball outside off to point
full on middle and leg. Soft hands and tapped off the front foot to the off side
overpitched just outside off. Guided to third man with soft hands

full toss on off stump, and driven to cover's right. Faf runs around from mid off, and has a throw at the stumps at the bowler's end. Not a direct hit, but there's a collision between Garg and Thakur. But both are okay
good length ball, wide outside off. Sticks the bat out and guides a shot to third man
full outside off stump. Lofts a drive over the infield. Chahar at deep extra cover runs around to intercept

short and wide. Good position for Saha to cut it over point, but he mistimes this loose ball. Straight to point and the CSK players are celebrating. But wait...Shardul has overstepped! Stop the celebrations, lets go back to the fielding positions. Saha survives, free hit time.
good length outside off. Confident punch off the back foot, but Ruturaj at point moves to his right to stop the ball
good length outside off, and the cut has been slapped behind point. Hazlewood at third man puts in the hard yards
full on middle. Inside out drive, but only to cover
full ball outside off and driven with the turn to long off for one
slower through the air. Full ball outside off and caresses a drive to deep extra cover
around the stumps again. Full on middle. He rocks back and clips it to midwicket's right
full outside off, and the first ball from the spinner ends up as a low full toss. Drilled to long on
overpitched ball wide outside off. Moving away in the air. Saha misses the full toss as he looks to drive. Hits the grass and through to the keeper
full toss on middle and leg. Slower ball clipped to deep backward square leg
full ball on his pads and nudged to deep midwicket
short and wide once again. So wide that Raina has to stop the ball from first slip

easy decision for the umpire as Bravo bowls the perfect full ball. Overpitched on off, and the ball straightens instead of coming into leg. Williamson flicks down the wrong line, and the ball goes past the bat to hit him on the front leg. He isn't reviewing that
length ball but very wide outside off. Going even further away as it goes beyond the tramlines. Dhoni has to scurry to his right to dive and stop any chance of extras
full outside off stump. Bends his knees and gently pushes a drive to cover
full on off, and worked off his toes to deep midwicket. Ball dribbles away for one

slips out of the hand but umpire Menon says that's a legal ball. Ball pops out of his fingers as he tries the knuckle ball. Goes high in the air but dips down sharply. Saha punches it with little control to the off side, but gets it beyond the cover fielder. Mid off runs around to stop it. But Saha would've been out had Raina grabbed it at cover since the umpire called it a legal ball. Sunrisers 41 for 1
deceived by the slower ball leg cutter. But it goes just above the bails! Good length on off. Saha swivels to pull. But he is through the shot way too early. On the bounce to MSD
takes the pace off. Slower ball, length on off and angling in. Ball stays low and worked off his pads to midwicket
scooped! Full just outside off stump. Williamson walks across to the off side and simply paddles it fine, over Dhoni. Perfect execution, four more for Sunrisers
good length ball outside off. Angling in and clipped confidently to midwicket
length ball outside off and punched along the ground. Raina dives around at cover to stop the shot
full just outside off. Small stride forward and then a lovely little lift over the bowler's head for four. Sweetly timed, and holds the pose too
good length just outside off. Angling into off. Tapped off the back foot to backward point
good length just outside off. Tapped back to the bowler's left. He gets a hand to it, but can't stop the duo from pinching a single
full outside off stump. Looks to defend away from his body. Past the edge to the keeper. Shardul wins this battle
good length outside off. Punched firmly off the back foot. Past Shardul's left, and Faf at mid off dives to intercept
good length on off and angling into leg. Tap and run to the leg side with Shardul giving the ball a chase

between the keeper-slip gap! Raina standing at second slip, and that leaves the gap. Length ball on off but doesn't angle in as much as KW expected. Tries to fend off the back foot, but it takes the edge and zoots right through the opening, Top Hazlewood over, could've had a second wicket over here
good length just outside off but angling in. Fended off the back foot
full on middle, and angling into his pads. Misses the flick. Hits the pad and rolls away to the leg side
bottom edge to the keeper. Fullish ball outside off. Roy dances down the track to make room and drag a shot through midwicket. Ball stays low, takes the feather touch, and Dhoni gobbles it up.
good length just outside off. Comfortably pulled along the ground to midwicket. Hazlewood will have to be careful with that length if the bounce is true

cramps Roy for space, but Hazlewood leaks extras. Back of a length on off and angling down leg. Going just past Roy's elbow as he tries to flick. Gets nothing, and Dhoni can't grab onto it either. It grazed his sleeve or glove, replays suggest
full on off stump. Smothers a drive down the ground to long on after taking a few steps down the ground
full on middle, and flicked to deep backward square leg. Thakur's right there

just a chip! But that's enough to get six more. In the slot, just outside off. Saha leans into a lofted drive, and then holds the pose as the ball goes over Chahar's head to long off. Just beyond the boundary line!
good length just outside off. Rides the bounce, and punches to cover off the back foot
sweet sound off the bat! Length ball outside off and angling into off. Saha stays on the back foot, swivels, and slogs it off his waist to deep midwicket for a six
Saha plays down the wrong line. Full just outside off. Saha looks to play a straight drive expecting the ball to come in. Instead it goes away after pitching, and whizzes past the outside edge
past the edge as Hazlewood induces a false shot from Roy. Length ball outside off. Looks to cut it late, but it goes through to Dhoni. Another ball that stays a tad low
nearly chopped on! Length ball just outside off. Too close to Saha's body for the cut but he goes for it anyway. Inside edge onto the deck and just over the bails!
good length ball just outside off but moving in. Fends off the back foot, but since its played with such soft hands the ball lands near his toes
good length on middle. Punched off the back foot, with the bat's face open. Pinged to point
good length outside off. Firmly punched off the back foot to cover
good length ball. Wide though, and angling further away. Saha looks to cut it square but misses. Stays a bit low again. Keeper has to jump forward to collect
outswing this time. Full outside off, and the crisp drive is destined for the boundary. But not when Faf is around. Runs to his left from mid off, and slides to stop the ball
fullish on off. Inswing this time. Moving into his pads, and he nudges it off his legs to square leg
away movement again as Saha looks to drive this full ball over cover. Ends up slicing it past point's left instead. Third man has to run around to slide and stop. Hazlewood with the effort
fullish, wider outside off. Pokes at it, and plays it to point
good length ball outside off. But seaming into him. Looks to tap it leg side. Inside edged to square leg
full on off stump. Stays low, and he prods forward to carefully defend off the front foot

that goes milesss into the deep midwicket stands, and Dhoni finishes it off with a six! Super Kings qualify for the playoffs, and become the first side this season to do that. A nervous finish for Super Kings, and in typical Dhoni style. That was overpitched on middle, as Dhoni got his front leg out of the way to heave that into the stands and eliminate Sunrisers
bowls short of a length outside off, as Dhoni pulls to the man at midwicket while playing from deep in his crease
slower ball, and pretty full and wide of off. He opens the bat face to drill that to deep point
starts with a bouncer, and that is called one for the over. Pitches it short and just outside off, as Rayudu lets that go hoping for it to be wide, but not given
change of pace. On a good length and wide of off, as Dhoni reaches out for it only to dab to cover again
yorker length on off, and pushed to the man at cover with the full face of the bat
finds the gap between deep midwicket and long-on! Short delivery outside off, and he pulls with his front leg out of the way. This over ends all of Sunrisers' little hopes
full ball and wide of off. Dhoni lets that go, and it is called wide
slower ball on a shortish length on off. Cut to deep point
launched into the long-on stands! Bhuvneshwar overpitches on middle, as Rayudu stands deep and clears his front leg to send that high and far into the boundary
yorker on off, and Dhoni gets that really low off his bat. Drilled to long-on after going low to play that
yorker length and just outside off. Rayudu again opens the bat face, but finds point, who tumbles to stop that
clears his front leg, and goes inside out over extra cover! Slower ball, and full and outside off. Enough width for Rayudu to play with, and he opens the bat face to slice that for four

Roy flies to his right and gets a hand, but that drops out after flicking his fingers! Dhoni lofts that fuller ball on off straight toward extra cover, but doesn't quite find the gap. Roy is not happy on dropping a tough catch
and again. This is on a good length on middle, and tailing in. Dhoni only manages a nudge to mid-off for another dot
at 137kph, and on a good length just outside off. Pushed to mid-off with an angled bat
Rayudu hangs deep in his crease, as this is full ball outside off. Driven to deep point as the ball makes a good sound off hiss bat
quick single nabbed. Rayudu pushes this good length ball on middle to cover, and they set off for a rapid run immediately
good length ball on off with change of pace again. This one gets extra bounce, as Rayudu drives to the man at cover
slower ball on a good length outside off, and he punches that to the right of point. Rashid at deep point runs to his left to slide and stop the ball
tucks this good length ball on off to the man at midwicket, as Bhuvneshwar doesn't give him the room to free his arms
full again, and just outside off. That was in the driving length, as Rayudu finds the man at cover
full delivery on middle, and angling in. Clipped to deep square leg with the closed face of the bat
bowls short and just outside off. The ball angles into Dhoni, who pulls to fine leg with a swivel

and du Plessis departs in the same over!. Holder changes his pace to bowl short and just outside off. du Plessis goes for the pull, but is almost off balance while trying to play from deep in his crease. The ball balloons for Kaul at midwicket to complete an easy take. Some late drama here, as Sunrisers strike twice in the over
good length ball just outside off, and he opens the bat face to tickle that to third man

traps him leg before! That was a yorker on middle - with Raina deep in his crease perhaps expecting the short delivery - as he plays across the line to try and flick that to the on side. But the ball pitches on middle, and looks to be striking middle stump too. Raina's run of low scores continues, as Holder nabs another. Replays show the ball would have rammed into off stump
yorker on middle, and tailing into him. Flicked to deep square leg from deep in his crease, and while almost falling over
and bowls short immediately to him. Pitches on leg, and angles into him, as Raina goes across to pull that low to fine leg
fullish and outside off. Turning away, as it is punched to cover, where there is a tumble, but no run conceded
fuller on middle and leg, and clipped toward square leg
full and outside off. He misses his flick, and it is a wide called

strange dismissal there! Moeen looks to heave that shortish ball on middle and leg across the line to the on side, but gets an inside edge near his groin, with the ball rolling off to the pitch and then striking the stumps. Those three dots earlier in the over may have forced him to go for a big one, as he has to depart
fullish on his pads, and flicks behind to the man at short fine. Moeen not happy with himself
sweeps this full ball on middle to the man at midwicket
goes short on middle, and cramps him for room. The ball turns in, as Moeen gets an inside edge to his pad as he looks to clip
slower ball, and on a good length wide of off. Moeen tickles that late to third man for a single
dipping full-toss outside leg, and he clips that to deep square leg after waiting for the ball to come to him
scrambled seam, and goes really full on off. Clipped to midwicket again
finds the fielder at midwicket this time, as he looks to pull this short ball wide of off
pulled over the man at midwicket, who jumps across to his left. Holder bowls short on off and from back of the hand, as du Plessis pulls to the right of long-on. Hundred up for Super Kings
looks to scoop this full ball on leg by making room and going low. But he gets it off the inside half of the bat toward fine leg, and still manages two
full ball on off, and he gets his drive off the inside half of the bat to deep midwicket
fuller and wide of off, dragged down to long-off while playing away from his body
just beats deep midwicket to his right! Rashid lands it short on middle, and Moeen pulls well despite the ball not quite getting up
good length again on middle, and turning in. Clipped back to the bowler
takes a step down and makes room, but pushes this full ball outside off to the man at cover
good length ball on middle, and punched back to the bowler from deep in his crease
pushed aerially to long-off, as Sandeep bowls on a good length and outside off

change of pace, and a full-toss wide of off. Drilled to deep point again, where Rashid runs to his left to cut that off yet again. He takes a slight tumble while stopping that, but manages to maintain his balance in the end
pretty full ball on leg, and clipped to fine leg to keep rotating the strike
gets an inside edge to this drive, as he goes after the full ball just outside off. They still steal a single, as the ball rolls over to the in side
slower ball, and on a good length and wide of off. Punched to the left of the man at deep point for a quick two
good length ball on middle and angling in, as it is clipped to deep midwicket from deep in his crease

pulled between fine leg and deep midwicket! Moeen brings out the pull to this short delivery on off, and finds the gap to place that well to deep square leg. A trademark Moeen pull. More agony for Sunrisers
short in length, and just outside off. A slower ball too, as it is dabbed to point
another short delivery outside off, and this time du Plessis pulls that slightly away from his body to deep square leg while playing with an angled bat
short of a length outside off, and angling in. Pulled to fine leg where, Rashid runs to his left to cut that off
flicks this good length ball outside leg to fine leg to get off the mark. Again there is extra bounce from Holder

taken by mid-off after leaping a little! Holder pitches it short outside off, and the ball bounces little more than usual - perhaps due to his height. Gaikwad looks to loft that over the in-field, but gets it off the higher side of the bat, maybe because he wasn't expecting to bounce more. Williamson at mid-off lifts his arms, and takes it above his head for a good catch
full just outside off stump. Defended to the off side
good length outside off. Turning in. Punched to cover point
full on middle. Plays it to midwicket where there's a big gap. Sharma has to give the ball a chase himself
full and wide outside off. Throws his bat at this. Cut to deep point
full on middle. Nudged off his toes to deep midwicket
drilled past! Excellent footwork. Full on middle and leg. But Gaikwad skips down the ground very quickly. And then generates solid power as he hits it down the ground past the umpire
good length on off. Turning in. Nudged to the leg side

that's been hit straight back to Rashid! Full ball outside off. He comes down the ground to smack it straight back. But he's hit it too straight. Hits Rashid's right hand but he feels okay to continue. Gaikwad asks Rashid if he's alright as well
full outside off. Turning away and Faf just smothers a drive along the carpet! Through cover, and between deep extra cover and long off
full outside off. Slapped to deep backward point
full on middle stump. Works this off his toes to the leg side for another single
full on middle. Tapped off the front foot to the leg side
full outside off. Skips down the ground and plays a hurried drive to deep extra cover
full on leg stump, and clipped off his toes to deep midwicket
full just outside off. Sliding in. Pushed back to the bowler
full on leg stump. Goes onto the back foot to nudge it leg side. But the ball turns across and takes the leading edge. Rolls away to point
tossed up. Nearly a yorker as the ball dips late. Dug away from around off stump
full outside off. Turning away from around the stumps. Pushed to cover's left
immense! Good length outside off. Transfers his weight onto the back foot, and slaps a cut in front of square! Races away to the extra-cover boundary
full and wide outside off. Softly pushed to cover

going, going, gone! For a brief moment it appeared like Faf would be out down the ground on the boundary line. But remember this is Sharjah. Fullish outside off. Big stride into the shot and then he lifts it with the full extension of the arms. Just soars over the fielder at long on
full on off stump. Angling into the pads, and clipped to deep midwicket. Played through the gap, and Samad fields in the deep
full outside off. Pushes this to cover off the front foot. Ball rolls away to the fielder
good length ball angling into off. Fended off the back foot to the bowler
fullish on off. Flicked once again to the leg side
good length on off. Sharp turn into him. Nudges it off his pads to the leg side
full on middle stump. Waits, and flicks off his toes to square leg off the back foot

and Rashid shows his experience Gaikwad looks to sweep this full ball. The googly turns in from off, goes below the glove, and hits the back leg. Looks plumb but Gaikwad reviews after the umpire raises his finger. However, the ball is touching the glove so umpire Menon has to change his decision. Gaikwad survives!

Gaikwad is showing scant respect for Rashid! Rashid tosses one up just outside off. The young Gaikwad comes down the ground and hits a beautiful shot back over Rashid's head for six. That's ten in two balls, and Gaikwad is attacking Rashid Khan!
full on middle. Looks to sweep right away. Top edged over Saha, and that's raced away off the outfield
full outside off. Slower ball this time. Drills the cover drive, but straight to cover
full onj middle. Faf moves to the leg side, skips down the wicket, and then clobbers a four over the bowler's head for four more.
full and wide outside off stump. Tries to hammer a four over cover by going inside out. Misses the shot completely
length ball outside off and he mistimes a dragged pull to mid on

full ball, in the slot. Faf goes deep in his crease while also moving to the leg side. Creates that added space and then drives it between Gaikwad's legs at the non-striker's end. Mid on can't cut it off either
back of a length outside off. But angling in. Rides the bounce to tap it to the off side. Quick single
punished! Bhuvneshwar isn't fast enough, and he's bowling a length ball too. Angling into him, and he opens his stance before muscling a flat-batted slap over deep midwicket/wide long on
good length outside off. Sticks the bat out to guide it past point to third man
better timing! Like the first ball of the over its Gaikwad coming down the track. Bhuvneshwar bowls a length ball that follows the batter. Angling into him and clubbed over deep midwicket
yorker. Dipping into leg stump. Dug away off his toes to point. Rashid runs around to intercept
comes down the ground to meet this full ball on middle. Slogs it over mid on, and lands safe beyond Holder. He runs towards cow corner to save a few runs
good length ball just outside off. Stands tall and cuts to point. Well recovered after that initial four
nearly chopped on! Good length outside off. Slower ball, and he is a bit early into the cut. Inside-edged onto his body
good length on middle, and flicked of his pads to square leg
fullish outside off. Mistimed off-side push off the front foot
fullish, just outside off stump. Defended off the front foot to the off side
starts off with four. Full on middle. Gaikwad backs away to the leg side, makes room, and lofts it over the bowler's head
fullish outside off. Backs away and punches through the off side. Stopped by a dive inside the circle
fullish, on off stump. Bends his knees and defends with soft hands
full on middle, and nudged off his pads to midwicket's right. Just a single
good length ball outside off. Looks to punch off the back foot. Just past the outside edge!
full outside off stump. Strides into a drive. Stopped inside the circle
full on leg stump. Wants to clip it fine behind square, but misses out. Goes down the leg side
